integrity: Exact integer enumeration/checker and proof included. The 16,000 ground-state count is known prior art. The seven-eigenvalue covariance spectrum is assessed as a new best-knowledge calculation, pending independent historical verification.
scientific_limitations: Finite 60-site homogeneous classical two-valued Ising model, exactly zero reference field. No thermodynamic limit, perturbations, quantum spins or response beyond the leading low-temperature covariance. The 1981 and 1993 exact Ising full texts were unavailable, leaving historical priority provisional.
title: Exact zero-temperature local-response spectrum of the C60 Ising antiferromagnet
